text:
Priya (Support): @Diego heads-up — seeing a spike of 500 errors in mobile SDK onboarding for trials over the last 24h. Android 11/12 most affected. :rotating_light:
Diego (CS): Thanks. Impact on paid accounts or just trials?
Priya (Support): Primarily trials so far. Conversion rate for the affected cohort down ~18%. One renewal flagged as at-risk (BrightSpot Labs).
Jordan (Solutions): Can you paste the error log you saw?
Priya (Support): ```
E/SDK: token refresh failed 401 Unauthorized — refresh_token invalid
payload: {"client":"mobile-android","ver":"2.3.1"}
```
Maya (Support): I reproduced on emulator. Flow stalls at "fetching profile" after email verify. Workaround: force sign-out -> sign-in sometimes works.
Diego (CS): This is both onboarding UX + renewal risk. Proposed comms + triage plan: 1) Eng/Runtime triage & hotfix, 2) Proactive outreach to impacted trials & renewal owners, 3) Enablement session for CS/Support on workarounds, 4) Capture feedback and update KB. Owner: Diego. ETA for first outreach: today EOD PST.
Jordan (Solutions): I'll ping eng-runtime and start a debug session. tagging @eng-runtime.
Priya (Support): Draft customer outreach (short): "We’re investigating a mobile onboarding issue affecting some new users. Temporary workaround: use web onboarding or clear app cache / force logout. We’ll follow up with ETA for fix and next steps"
Maya (Support): Add a line to include a direct contact for urgent activation. Also mention we’ll credit affected trials if needed.
Diego (CS): Outline of actions (owners + SLAs):
- Eng (Jordan): root cause analysis & patch — target 6 hours
- CS (Diego): proactive outreach to top-10 impacted + renewal flags — target tonight
- Support (Priya, Maya): KB + step-by-step workaround + survey link — target 3 hours
- Solutions (Jordan): patch notes + rollback guidance — target 6 hours
Diego (CS): I scheduled a quick enablement sync at 11:30 PST — invites sent to CS, Support, Sales. :calendar:
Maya (Support): Proposed survey (3 quick Qs + optional comment): "Were you able to complete onboarding?", "Did you find the workaround helpful?", "Any blockers?" plus NPS.
support-bot: Incident created INC-2026-4723 — bridge posted to #eng-runtime and incident runbook created: https://incidents.redwood/INC-2026-4723
Diego (CS): I’ll draft the final comms copy and post here before sending. Please add any legal/credit notes if you think we should offer trial compensation. :thumbsup:
Priya (Support): Marking this high priority for retention. Will update thread with any repro steps or customer replies.
Jordan (Solutions): Eng acknowledged, spinning up debug nodes. Will report back with root cause or mitigation in ~2 hours.
Diego (CS): Thanks everyone — keep updates here. If any cancellation signals appear, tag me directly so we can escalate to account exec. :eyes:
